meta.rule: a parameter without source_id and locator fails the build
meta.generator: manual extraction from the cited NIST reports by Claude (Fable 5.1), 2026-09-10; human review: pending

conventions.units: value is in `unit`. Where the report states feet-and-inches the value is the exact integer/decimal inch count and `value_raw` holds the report's own notation. Whole-foot statements stay in ft. Strings and lists carry unit null.
conventions.quotes: locator.quote is transcribed from the report's OCR text layer with obvious OCR errors corrected (e.g. 'comers' -> 'corners', 'fonn' -> 'form'). Figure callouts are quoted exactly as lettered on the figure.
conventions.pdf_page: 1-based page index of the downloaded PDF. printed_page is the number printed on that page.
conventions.applies_to: wtc1 | wtc2 | towers (stated for both) | complex
conventions.conflicts: Where two passages or two reports give different numbers, both are recorded as separate params and cross-referenced in notes. Nothing is averaged or chosen here; choosing is a paradata decision.
